mapper.select: SELECT QNA_NO , QNA_USER_ID , CSR_NO , QNA_TITLE , QNA_CONTENTS , ANSWER_YN , REG_DATE , UPDT_DATE FROM qna_info WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC LIMIT #{startNum}, #{pageCnt}

SELECT TQI.QNA_NO, TQI.QNA_USER_ID, TQI.CSR_NO, TQI.QNA_TITLE, TQI.QNA_CONTENTS, TQI.ANSWER_YN, TQI.REG_DATE, TQI.UPDT_DATE, TQR.QNA_REPLY_NO, TQR.QNA_REPLY_CONTENTS, TQR.REG_DATE AS REPLY_REG_DATE, TQR.UPDT_DATE AS REPLY_UPDT_DATE FROM qna_info TQI LEFT JOIN qna_reply TQR ON TQI.QNA_NO = TQR.QNA_NO WHERE TQI.QNA_NO = #{qnaNo}

SELECT TQI.QNA_NO , TQI.QNA_USER_ID , TQI.CSR_NO , TQI.QNA_TITLE , TQI.QNA_CONTENTS , TQI.ANSWER_YN , TQI.REG_DATE , TQI.UPDT_DATE , TQR.QNA_REPLY_NO , TQR.QNA_REPLY_CONTENTS , TQR.UPDT_DATE AS REPLY_UPDT_DATE , TCI.CSR_NAME FROM qna_info TQI LEFT JOIN qna_reply TQR ON TQI.QNA_NO = TQR.QNA_NO LEFT JOIN csr_info TCI ON TQI.CSR_NO = TCI.CSR_NO WHERE TQI.QNA_NO = #{qnaNo} AND QNA_USER_ID = #{qnaUserId}
SELECT QNA_USER_PWD FROM qna_info WHERE QNA_NO = #{qnaNo} AND QNA_USER_ID = #{qnaUserId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE qna_info SET
QNA_TITLE=#{qnaTitle},
QNA_CONTENTS=#{qnaContents},
UPDT_DATE=NOW() WHERE QNA_NO = #{qnaNo} AND QNA_USER_ID =#{qnaUserId}
UPDATE qna_reply SET QNA_REPLY_CONTENTS=#{qnaReplyContents}, UPDT_DATE=NOW(), UPDT_CRS_NO=#{updtCrsNo} WHERE QNA_REPLY_NO = #{qnaReplyNo}
